description: Persona prompt honesty reword. server/src/prompts/persona.ts (~line 8) currently claims the assistant has 'real-time access to the user's live spreadsheet data ... and the full formula dependency graph.' This is false — the model receives a lossy point-in-time snapshot with limited coverage. Reword to accurately describe a snapshot with explicit, possibly-partial coverage. Independent of FEAT-001 (different file). A wording correction, not a rewrite.
steps: server/src/prompts/persona.ts: replace the sentence 'You have real-time access to the user's live spreadsheet data (cell values, formulas, structure), audit findings (errors, inconsistencies), and the full formula dependency graph.' (and any adjacent sentence reinforcing the overclaim) with an honest version: the model is given a point-in-time snapshot of the spreadsheet with explicit, possibly-partial coverage — cell values, formulas, structure, and audit findings — not real-time/live access and not a full formula dependency graph. Remove the words 'real-time', 'live', and 'full formula dependency graph'. Keep tone, length, and surrounding bullet structure intact.
acceptance_criteria: server/src/prompts/persona.ts no longer contains 'real-time', 'live', or 'full formula dependency graph' in the identity paragraph.
The reworded text describes a point-in-time snapshot with possibly-partial coverage.
`git diff server/src/prompts/persona.ts` shows only the reworded sentence(s) — no structural or tone changes.
findings: Replaced the overclaim sentence in server/src/prompts/persona.ts (identity paragraph) with: 'You are given a point-in-time snapshot of the user's spreadsheet with explicit, possibly-partial coverage — cell values, formulas, structure, and audit findings (errors, inconsistencies). Work from what the snapshot actually contains; it may not include every cell or dependency.' Removed 'real-time', 'live', and 'full formula dependency graph'. Only persona.ts changed (1 insertion, 1 deletion). `npm run build --prefix server` passed.
